hypotheses.title: Causal decision-time IV rank conditions forward option-premium response
hypotheses.statement: For prospectively enrolled SHFE ag and au long-call decision intents, events with product-local causal signal-day IV rank less than or equal to 0.66 have a higher mean 17-completed-daily-bar option-premium close return than events with rank greater than 0.66.

source_refs.claim: The repository records a look-ahead-free expanding-window IV-rank rule with warmup 40 and a fixed maximum rank of 0.66.
Signal-day IV is a pre-outcome cost input and rich IV is a distinct mechanism from structural-label direction.
Gate choice must use decision-time information only and posterior fields may not enter eligibility.

causal_decision_time_inputs.name: immutable decision intent joined to the snapshot-selected long-call leg
causal_decision_time_inputs.rule: Join pa_feitian_decision_intent_v1 to pa_feitian_snapshot_v1 by signal_id and use only the snapshot's selected_option_contract and matching options_calls metadata; never rescan or reselect a contract.

causal_decision_time_inputs.name: signal-day option close, underlying futures close, strike, exact expiry, and risk-free-rate convention
causal_decision_time_inputs.rule: Invert IV with engine.options.black76.implied_vol using option_type C, annual continuously compounded r=0.02, expiry at 15:00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the recorded expiry date, and ACT/365F elapsed seconds from the observed option-close timestamp.

causal_decision_time_inputs.name: prior product-local signal-day IV history
causal_decision_time_inputs.available_by: strictly before the current decision timestamp
causal_decision_time_inputs.rule: Use finite IVs from earlier eligible signals for the same product only; current and future IVs are forbidden.

exclusions.rule: Exclude events with fewer than 40 finite earlier signal-day IV observations for the same product.
exclusions.reason: The causal rank is undefined during warmup.

exclusions.rule: Exclude missing, non-positive, synthetic, or non-hash-bound option prices and any IV inversion without exact strike and expiry.
exclusions.reason: The experiment tests observed decision-time IV, not a model-generated market path.

exclusions.rule: Exclude events without the seventeenth subsequent completed daily option close; do not shorten or substitute the horizon.
exclusions.reason: The forward response horizon is frozen.

exclusions.rule: Deduplicate by stable signal id and selected contract symbol before reading any forward close; retain artifact hashes as provenance and exclude every copy when a stable key has conflicting provenance or decision-time fields.
exclusions.reason: One stable decision and leg contributes at most one observation even if its artifacts are regenerated.

falsification.primary_estimand: equal-weighted arithmetic mean of the ag and au within-product differences: mean premium close return for rank<=0.66 minus mean premium close return for rank>0.66
falsification.uncertainty: A separate 95% percentile interval in each staged window from 2000 valid seed-42001 circular moving-block bootstrap replicates over 17 completed SHFE trading-day date bins, preserving same-date ag/au events and fixed rank assignments; windows are never pooled.
falsification.supported_when: The training and validation gates pass without adaptation, the single-use holdout sample gate passes, and the holdout interval lower bound is strictly greater than zero.
falsification.falsified_when: The first evaluated training, validation, or single-use holdout window whose sample gate passes has an interval upper bound less than or equal to zero.
falsification.inconclusive_when: An evaluated window fails its minimum sample or valid-replicate gate, or its interval lower bound is less than or equal to zero and its upper bound is strictly greater than zero; later windows remain sealed.

hypotheses.title: A no-fixed-target runner preserves option convexity relative to staged profit taking
hypotheses.statement: On the same eligible event, selected option leg, entry, stop, and 17-completed-daily-bar horizon, a no-fixed-profit-target runner has higher paired mean premium R and a higher at-least-2R outcome share than a staged fixed-target policy.

selection_reasoning_fixed_pre_outcome: It isolates one causal decision-time cost mechanism with an existing pure implementation and fixed 40-observation warmup and 0.66 cutoff.
It does not require the unresolved authentic DD-line, 1B or 2B, structural-stop, or staged-target definitions.
It preserves the selected event and option leg and therefore cannot rescue M6-EXP-013 by relabelling its structural proxy.
It can fail closed using observed prices, exact contract metadata, immutable decision intent, and two fixed prospective windows.

event_source.selection_rule: Retain every finalized in-window decision intent that joins one-to-one to a snapshot signal with an already-selected long-call contract and all frozen eligibility inputs hash-bound; use only snapshot selected_option_contract plus its matching options_calls metadata and do not rerun score_today, scan contracts, or reselect a leg.
event_source.admission_deadline: 12:00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the calendar day after the decision date
event_source.admission_ledger_rule: Before the deadline, append candidate artifact-pair hashes and decision-time fields to an immutable per-decision-date enrollment ledger; artifacts first seen after the sealed deadline are audit-only late revisions and cannot enter or alter rank history.
event_source.pre_ranking_conflict_pass: Before computing any rank for a staged window, scan all sealed enrollment-ledger entries from history initialization through that window end by stable deduplication key.
event_source.duplicate_resolution_rule: Within the sealed ledgers, retain one observation only when every copy has identical provenance hashes and decision-time fields; otherwise mark the stable key conflicted and exclude every copy before constructing IV history. Late audit-only revisions never trigger rollback or recomputation.

ordered_eligibility: decision date is inside exactly one frozen enrollment window
exchange, product, and option type are in the frozen universe
snapshot and decision intent are immutable and hash-bound
the artifact pair was admitted by its deadline and the global pre-ranking conflict pass retained exactly one conflict-free stable key
the selected contract, strike, exact expiry, option close, underlying futures close, and timestamps were available at the finalized decision-day close
Black-76 implied volatility with r=0.02 and option_type C is finite
at least 40 finite same-product signal-day IV observations exist strictly before the current event
the seventeenth subsequent completed daily option close exists by the outcome cutoff

time_to_expiry.expiry_timestamp_rule: 15:00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the exact recorded expiry date
time_to_expiry.decision_timestamp_rule: timestamp of the observed decision-time option close

iv_rank.history_update_eligibility: Append every unique in-window same-product decision with a finite decision-time IV after ranking it, including warmup events and events later excluded for a missing 17-bar outcome.
iv_rank.same_timestamp_batch_rule: Rank every same-product event sharing a decision timestamp against history from strictly earlier timestamps, then append the batch in deduplication-key bytewise order.

sample_gate.stage_rule: Apply every per-window threshold independently before advancing to the next sealed window.

sequential_evaluation.training_gate: Evaluate P1-W1 only. Advance without parameter changes only when its sample and valid-replicate gates pass and its 95% interval lower bound is strictly greater than zero; otherwise terminate as falsified when the upper bound is less than or equal to zero, or inconclusive when the gate fails or the interval strictly straddles zero.
sequential_evaluation.validation_gate: Keep P1-W2 sealed until an immutable hash-bound P1-W1 result manifest records a passing training gate. Evaluate P1-W2 once under the identical design and advance only under the identical positive-lower-bound rule; otherwise terminate and keep P1-W3 sealed.
sequential_evaluation.single_use_holdout: Keep P1-W3 sealed until immutable hash-bound P1-W1 and P1-W2 result manifests both record passing gates. Evaluate P1-W3 exactly once under the identical design; its interval and sample gate alone determine the final supported, falsified, or inconclusive classification.
sequential_evaluation.result_manifest_binding: Each stage manifest binds the registry SHA-256, canonical design SHA-256, admitted enrollment-ledger hashes, source artifact hashes, stage id, bootstrap algorithm version, seed, and result hash before the next stage is unsealed.

secondary_diagnostics: ag and au within-product rank-cell mean-return contrasts
event counts and exclusions by product and window

bootstrap.calendar: Every completed SHFE trading date in the one currently evaluated frozen window, including dates with zero eligible events.
bootstrap.application: Run separately for P1-W1, then P1-W2 only if unlocked, then P1-W3 only if unlocked; never combine observations or replicate estimates across windows.
bootstrap.date_bin: All eligible ag and au events sharing a decision date move together.
bootstrap.block_start_rule: Sample start indices uniformly with replacement from all completed trading dates in the window; each block wraps within that same window.
bootstrap.sample_length_rule: Concatenate blocks until the original window calendar length is reached and truncate excess dates.
bootstrap.replicate_estimand: Recompute the ag and au within-product rank-cell mean differences and their fixed 0.5/0.5 arithmetic mean.
bootstrap.invalid_replicate_rule: Discard a replicate if any ag or au rank cell is empty; draw a replacement until 2000 valid replicates or 20000 total attempts.
bootstrap.insufficient_valid_replicates_action: If fewer than 2000 valid replicates are produced in 20000 attempts, classify the result inconclusive.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided percentile interval over sorted valid replicate estimates with linear interpolation at p*(n-1) for p=0.025 and p=0.975.

classification.supported: P1-W1 and P1-W2 passed without adaptation, and the single-use P1-W3 sample gate passes with its 95% interval lower bound greater than zero
classification.falsified: the current stage sample gate passes and its 95% interval upper bound is less than or equal to zero; later stages remain sealed
classification.inconclusive: the current stage sample gate fails, fewer than 2000 valid replicates are produced, or its 95% interval lower bound is less than or equal to zero and its upper bound is strictly greater than zero; later stages remain sealed

prohibited_adaptations: change the 0.66 rank cutoff or rank tie rule
change stable event deduplication, conflict exclusion, or provenance bindings

change within-product contrasts, fixed 0.5/0.5 product weights, or the 17-day moving-block bootstrap
pool staged windows, inspect a sealed window early, repeat the holdout, or adapt between windows
replace observed decision-time prices or future closes with modeled prices

material_distinction_from_m6_exp_013: M6-EXP-013 tested a six-label structural-direction mapping; P1-EXP-001 tests decision-time implied-volatility cost rank and uses no structural-label mapping.

M6-EXP-013 used a fixed retrospective eight-series daily corpus split into training and holdout; P1-EXP-001 enrolls every eligible immutable decision intent into calendar-fixed prospective training, validation, and single-use holdout windows.
M6-EXP-013 screened 1, 3, and 5-bar directional responses; P1-EXP-001 has one frozen 17-bar premium-close response and no horizon search.
M6-EXP-013 produced an empty candidate set and remains rejected; P1-EXP-001 neither relaxes nor reuses that candidate gate.

amendment_policy.correction_before_enrollment: Create a new registry version and a new freeze lock; do not edit v1 in place.
amendment_policy.change_after_enrollment_or_outcome_inspe: Invalidate P1-EXP-001 and register a new experiment id under a new registry version.
amendment_policy.result_binding: Any future result manifest must record the exact registry file SHA-256 and selected-experiment canonical-design SHA-256 from the committed freeze lock.
